summary: Implemented the Tabs feature without committing; nothing was run, so the tests are unverified. Changes: new src/textual/widgets/tabs.py (Tab, TabsRenderable, Tabs); UnderlineBar gains clickable_ranges before width and yields one Text with click spans last; Opacity merges blended color into the existing style, preserving meta; the layout resolver needed no change because Edge already declares min_size=1. Tests added in tests/renderables/test_underline_bar.py and tests/widgets/test_tabs.py. Also added docs/reference/tabs.md and sandbox/tabs_demo.py/.css. Decisions to review: bar position uses displayed-tab indices (differs from find_tab_by_name only when a duplicate name precedes the active one); letter search skips tabs sharing the active name; can_focus=True is set. Known limitation: an empty tab label has zero width, which the resolver treats as flexible, so it gets at least one cell.
